hotel_name: Villa Igiea, a Rocco Forte Hotel

claims.text: Villa Igiea was built in 1900, at the height of the Belle Epoque.

findings.quote: Built in 1900 at the height of the Belle Époque
findings.note: built 1900 at height of Belle Epoque

claims.text: The Florio family turned Villa Igiea from a private palazzo into a hotel.

findings.quote: Villa Igiea was transformed by the Florio family from a private palazzo into one of Sicily’s most refined hotels
findings.note: Florio family transformed palazzo into hotel

claims.text: The palazzo sits at the edge of Palermo, at the foot of Mount Pellegrino on the Gulf of Palermo.

findings.quote: a turn-of-the-century palazzo at the perimeter of vivid Palermo, the foot of Mount Pellegrino and the Gulf of Palermo

claims.text: The Florio Restaurant menu is designed by Chef Fulvio Pierangelini.

findings.quote: Designed by Chef Fulvio Pierangelini, the menu reflects a philosophy of simplicity, generosity and ultimate quality

claims.text: Alicetta is a bistro on terraces between the garden and the sea.

findings.quote: Perched on terraces that float between the magnificent garden and the sea, Alicetta offers an enchanting view and it becomes a bona fide bistro.
findings.note: bistro on terraces between garden and sea

claims.text: Aperitivo hour at the bar takes place in the villa's sandstone vaults, with a wide selection of Florio liqueurs.

findings.quote: Discover the true meaning of aperitivo hour in Villa Igiea’s elegant sandstone vaults, and uncover the widest selection of Florio liqueurs.

claims.text: The Donna Franca Suite has a separate living room and a sea-view terrace with lounges and sunbeds.

findings.quote: with a separate living room and the added luxury of a breezy sea-view terrace, outfitted with lounges and sunbeds

claims.text: Rocco Forte took over Villa Igiea in 2019.

findings.quote: The hotelier took it over in 2019

claims.text: The rooms reflect the design of Olga Polizzi, Rocco Forte's sister.

findings.quote: The rooms are where you will feel the modern touch of Olga Polizzi, Rocco’s sister

claims.text: The Irene Forte spa uses Irene Forte skincare, made with botanicals from the Verdura Resort farm.

findings.quote: The Irene Forte spa features the eponymous skincare line that Irene, one of Rocco’s two daughters, has created using botanicals from the family’s Verdura Resort’s farm

claims.text: The hotel has a pool and tennis courts.

findings.quote: With its pool and tennis courts, this place is comfortable for families.

claims.text: The hotel offers boat trips along the Mondello coast that include the Capo Gallo Nature Reserve.

findings.quote: Enjoy a relaxing boat trip along Mondello’s stunning coast. Swim in turquoise waters, explore hidden coves, and discover Capo Gallo Nature Reserve.

claims.text: The George V Suite is named after King George V, who stayed at the villa during his 1925 visit to Sicily.

findings.quote: named after King George V, who took residence here during his visit to Sicily in 1925

claims.text: Florio Restaurant is set in the villa's historic Louis XVI hall.

findings.quote: where the Florios’ most distinguished guests once dined in this historic Louis XVI hall

claims.text: Alicetta is enclosed in a metal pavilion modelled on the pavilion of the Palazzo Butera.

findings.quote: Alicetta is enclosed in a pretty metal pavilion modelled on the same design as the pavilion of the Palazzo Butera

claims.text: Igiea Terrazza Bar overlooks the Gulf of Palermo and is set among 1950s frescoes.

findings.quote: Overlooking the shimmering Gulf of Palermo, Igiea Terrazza Bar is where elegance, heritage and Mediterranean light come together. Set among 1950s frescoes

claims.text: The villa was used as a film backdrop by de Sica and Sordi.

findings.quote: It then became a cinematic backdrop, used by de Sica and Sordi.

claims.text: The hotel is on the coast, about a 15-minute drive from central Palermo, in a suburban neighborhood.

findings.quote: The hotel is located along the coast, about a 15-minute drive from central Palermo
The neighborhood around the resort is suburban

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing typical of high-end heritage properties.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have limited modern amenities in some areas.
